problem: S0..S9 built the Studio Intelligence Decision flow incrementally, each phase verifying one link -- but no phase had yet confirmed the WHOLE chain holds together, end-to-end, for every goal simultaneously, with every prior DEFERRED/RESOLVED verdict still real at closure time.

decision.decision_summary: All 4 production goals fully connected end-to-end: true. Existing verdicts re-verified and hold: GPU infra DEFERRED=true, ghibli RESOLVED=true, semantic_quality BLOCKED=true. action.action_summary: Re-verified the complete 7-stage chain for all 4 production goals and re-confirmed every existing DEFERRED/RESOLVED verdict from S2/S5/S7/S8/S9 still holds; wrote the closing Operational Readiness Manifest.

result.note: Operational readiness does not require an executable action to exist right now -- it requires every goal's chain to be real, connected, and honestly classified, which this phase confirmed for all 4.

cause.root_cause_summary: An incrementally-built decision flow needs one final integration pass that touches every goal and every link simultaneously -- individual phase-by-phase correctness does not by itself prove the whole system holds together at once.

lesson: Readiness is not the same as "something is actionable right now" -- a system where every real chain is honestly resolved, correctly deferred with a real reason, or correctly marked not-applicable by a documented rule is operationally ready even when 0 actions are currently executable. Confusing readiness with actionability would pressure future phases toward forcing action where none is warranted.
